question: [scripted] Does the simulated fly's escape response habituate when the looming stimulus repeats every 10 s on a fixed schedule?
hypothesis: [scripted] Repeating the stimuli every 10 s lowers the fraction answered by an escape, compared with the same stimuli every 90 s.
